project.name: autoresearch
project.description: Autonomous AI research platform: an LLM agent that runs ML experiments overnight, modifying a single training file, training for 5 minutes per run, and keeping only improvements.

key_design_principles: Single file for agent to modify (train.py)
Fixed 5-minute wall-clock time budget per experiment
Vocab-size-independent evaluation metric (val_bpb — bits per byte)
Self-contained: no distributed training, one GPU, one metric
Agent never pauses to ask the human for input
data_flow: val_bpb compared to baseline → keep or revert commit
experiment_loop: Read current git state of train.py
Apply one modification (architecture, hyperparams, optimizer, etc.)
Extract val_bpb and peak_vram_mb from output
If improved: keep commit; else: git reset

prepare.py.purpose: One-time data preparation and shared runtime utilities. Never modified by the agent.

TIME_BUDGET.description: Training time budget in seconds (5 minutes)

EVAL_TOKENS.description: Total tokens used for validation evaluation

SPLIT_PATTERN.description: Token split pattern with \p{N}{1,2} instead of {1,3}

CACHE_DIR.description: Base cache directory for data and tokenizer

download_single_shard.description: Download one parquet shard from Hugging Face with up to 5 retry attempts and exponential back-off.

parameters.index: shard integer index (zero-padded to 5 digits in filename)

download_single_shard.returns: True on success, False on all retries failed

download_data.description: Download the requested number of training shards plus the pinned validation shard using a multiprocessing pool.

parameters.num_shards: number of training shards to download

list_parquet_files.description: Return sorted list of parquet file paths found in DATA_DIR.

text_iterator.description: Yield documents from training parquet shards (excludes pinned val shard) up to max_chars total characters.

train_tokenizer.description: Train a BPE tokenizer using rustbpe on training corpus, then build tiktoken Encoding. Saves tokenizer.pkl and token_bytes.pt. Also runs a roundtrip sanity check.

get_token_bytes.description: Load and return the token→byte-length lookup tensor used by BPB evaluation.

_document_batches.description: Infinite iterator over batches of raw documents from the correct parquet split. Yields (doc_batch, epoch).

make_dataloader.signature: make_dataloader(tokenizer: Tokenizer, B: int, T: int, split: str, buffer_size: int = 1000) -> Iterator[tuple[Tensor, Tensor, int]]
make_dataloader.description: BOS-aligned dataloader with best-fit document packing. Every row starts with BOS. Uses best-fit bin-packing to achieve 100% token utilisation (no padding). Falls back to cropping the shortest buffered document when no document fits remaining space. Yields (inputs, targets, epoch) with data pre-loaded onto CUDA.

parameters.buffer_size: minimum number of tokenised documents to buffer

evaluate_bpb.description: Compute bits-per-byte on the pinned validation shard. Sums per-token cross-entropy (nats) and total byte lengths, then converts: bpb = total_nats / (ln(2) * total_bytes). Special tokens (byte_length = 0) are excluded from both sums. Uses fixed MAX_SEQ_LEN so results are comparable across configs.

Tokenizer.description: Minimal wrapper around a tiktoken Encoding object.

class_methods.from_directory: cls.from_directory(tokenizer_dir) — load pickled encoding from disk

instance_methods.get_bos_token_id: Returns integer id of the BOS special token
instance_methods.encode: Encode a string or list of strings with optional BOS prepend (multi-threaded for lists)
instance_methods.decode: Decode list of token ids back to string

train.py.purpose: Full training pipeline: GPT model definition, hybrid optimizer, hyperparameters, and training loop. This is the single file that the agent modifies between experiments.

model.name: GPT
model.description: Decoder-only transformer language model with sliding-window attention, rotary embeddings, value residuals, per-layer scaling, and logit soft-capping.

window_pattern.description: Per-layer attention window pattern: L=full, S=half context. Repeats cyclically; last layer always forced to L.

helper_functions.has_ve: Returns True if layer_idx should have a Value Embedding (alternating, last layer always included)
helper_functions.apply_rotary_emb: Split head_dim in half and apply RoPE: y1 = x1·cos + x2·sin, y2 = -x1·sin + x2·cos

CausalSelfAttention.description: Multi-head causal self-attention with optional Value Embedding (ResFormer-style), RoPE, QK-norm, and Flash Attention 3.

steps: Value residual: if VE layer, compute gate = 2·σ(ve_gate(x[..,:32])), mix v = v + gate·ve
Apply RoPE to q and k
Flash Attention 3 (causal, sliding window if S-layer)
Reshape and project output via c_proj

MLP.description: Two-layer feedforward block with squared ReLU activation.

Block.description: Single transformer block: residual attention + residual MLP, both pre-normalised.
Block.forward: x = x + attn(norm(x), ...); x = x + mlp(norm(x))

GPT.description: Full GPT model with token embeddings, transformer blocks, value embedding table, rotary embedding buffers, per-layer residual scaling, skip-connection mixing, and soft-capped logit head.

sub_modules.lm_head: Linear(n_embd, vocab_size, bias=False) — language model head
sub_modules.x0_lambdas: Learnable per-layer skip-connection mix weight (initialised to 0.1)
sub_modules.value_embeds: ModuleDict of Embedding(vocab_size, kv_dim) for VE layers

forward_pass: For each block i: x = resid_lambdas[i]·x + x0_lambdas[i]·x0; x = block(x, ve_i, cos_sin, window_size_i)
If targets provided: return cross_entropy(logits, targets)

weight_init.ve_gate: Zeros (sigmoid(0)=0.5 → gate=1.0 is neutral at init)

methods.init_weights: Initialise all parameters as documented above
methods._precompute_rotary_embeddings: Compute cos/sin buffers for RoPE up to rotary_seq_len = sequence_len × 10
methods._compute_window_sizes: Map window_pattern characters to (window_size, 0) tuples; force last layer to L (full context)
methods.estimate_flops: Estimate forward+backward FLOPs per token (6·non-embed-params + attention FLOPs)
methods.num_scaling_params: Return dict of parameter counts by group
methods.setup_optimizer: Create MuonAdamW with per-group LR, scaled by 1/√(n_embd/768)

optimizer.name: MuonAdamW
optimizer.description: Hybrid optimizer: Muon for 2D matrix parameters (attention + MLP weights), AdamW for everything else (embeddings, unembeddings, per-layer scalars). Single-GPU only.

adamw_step_fused.description: Fused AdamW step: weight-decay, EMA update, bias-corrected parameter update — all in one compiled kernel.

muon_step_fused.description: Fused Muon step: Nesterov momentum → Polar Express orthogonalisation → NorMuon variance reduction → cautious weight decay → parameter update.

polar_express.description: Iterative matrix square-root approximation (5 coefficients), computing the nearest orthogonal matrix of the gradient.
polar_express.steps: ns_steps iterations of X = a·X + X·B (or B·X for tall matrices) where B = b·A + c·A²

muon_step_fused.normuon: Per-head variance normalisation: adaptive step size via second-moment buffer
muon_step_fused.cautious_wd: Weight decay masked to parameters whose gradient and value have the same sign

ASPECT_RATIO.description: model_dim = DEPTH × ASPECT_RATIO (rounded up to nearest HEAD_DIM multiple)

WINDOW_PATTERN.description: Attention window pattern per layer block (L=full, S=half context, cycles and last always L)

TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE.description: Tokens per optimizer step (across gradient accumulation micro-steps)

WARMUP_RATIO.description: Fraction of TIME_BUDGET spent on LR linear warm-up

WARMDOWN_RATIO.description: Fraction of TIME_BUDGET spent on cosine/linear LR cool-down

FINAL_LR_FRAC.description: Final LR as fraction of peak LR

EMBEDDING_LR.description: Adam LR for wte and value embeddings

MATRIX_LR.description: Muon LR for attention and MLP weight matrices

SCALAR_LR.description: Adam LR for per-layer scalar parameters

WEIGHT_DECAY.description: Cautious weight decay for Muon (linearly annealed to 0 during training)

training_loop.description: Fixed 5-minute wall-clock training loop with gradient accumulation, dynamic LR scheduling, dynamic Muon momentum, and Python GC freeze.
setup: Instantiate GPT on meta device, move to CUDA, call init_weights()
Create train dataloader, prefetch first batch
per_step: Accumulate gradients over grad_accum_steps micro-steps with autocast (bfloat16)
Update Muon weight decay: WEIGHT_DECAY × (1 − progress)
Log step, loss (EMA), LR multiplier, tok/s, MFU%, remaining time
training_loop.gc_management: Freeze Python GC after step 0 to avoid ~500ms stalls; collect every 5000 steps
training_loop.termination: Break when total_training_time >= TIME_BUDGET (only counted after step 10 to exclude torch.compile warmup)
training_loop.evaluation: After loop: model.eval(); evaluate_bpb(model, tokenizer, DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE)

schedules.get_lr_multiplier: Linear warm-up from 0→1 over WARMUP_RATIO, flat at 1 until (1−WARMDOWN_RATIO), linear cool-down to FINAL_LR_FRAC
schedules.get_muon_momentum: Ramp from 0.85 to 0.95 over first 300 steps
schedules.get_weight_decay: Linear anneal from WEIGHT_DECAY to 0 over training duration

program.md.purpose: Agent protocol and instructions. Edited by the human to define the research strategy.

setup_phase: Create a new git branch for the experiment run
Read results.tsv if it exists (understand experiment history)
Create results.tsv with header if it doesn't exist
experiment_loop: Read current git log and train.py
Extract val_bpb and peak_vram_mb from run.log
If val_bpb improved: keep commit; else: git reset --hard HEAD~1
constraints: Keep each run under ~10 minutes total wall time
Prioritise simplicity — only keep changes that clearly improve performance
Never pause to ask the human to continue

kernels.description: Flash Attention 3 operator kernels (varunneal/FA3 for Hopper, kernels-community/flash-attn3 for others)

pyarrow.description: Parquet file I/O for dataset shards

attention.type: Multi-head causal self-attention with optional grouped-query attention (GQA)
attention.kernel: Flash Attention 3 (varunneal/FA3 on Hopper H100; kernels-community/flash-attn3 on other NVIDIA GPUs)
attention.positional_encoding: Rotary Position Embeddings (RoPE) — base 10000, pre-computed up to sequence_len×10
attention.normalization: QK-norm (RMS norm on Q and K before attention)
attention.sliding_window: Pattern-driven: S-layers use window = sequence_len/2, L-layers use full sequence_len. Last layer always full.

value_residual.name: ResFormer-style Value Embedding (VE)
value_residual.description: Alternating layers have a second per-token value embedding. The input-dependent gate (32-channel linear → sigmoid × 2) mixes the standard value projection with this embedding.

logit_softcap.description: Logits are soft-capped to ±15 via 15·tanh(logits/15) to prevent training instability.

memory_efficiency.pre_allocated_buffers: row_buffer (CPU), cpu_buffer (pinned), gpu_buffer (CUDA) pre-allocated in make_dataloader
memory_efficiency.gc_freeze: gc.collect(); gc.freeze(); gc.disable() after step 0 to eliminate GC stalls
memory_efficiency.bfloat16: autocast(dtype=torch.bfloat16) for forward/backward; embeddings stored in bfloat16

key_technical_details.compilation: torch.compile(model, dynamic=False) — whole-graph compilation for maximum throughput

evaluation_metric.name: val_bpb
properties: Vocab-size independent (normalised by byte length, not token count)
Special tokens excluded from both numerator and denominator
